name: Star Alliance International Corp.
summary: Star Alliance International Corp. is globally involved in the acquisition and development of mining properties, particularly those yielding gold and other precious minerals. A significant asset in its portfolio is an interest in the Troy mining property, situated in Mariposa County, California. This particular holding comprises 78 gold mining claims, encompassing an expansive area of approximately 4,800 acres. The company, which was established in 2014, previously operated under the name Asteriko Corp. before officially changing to Star Alliance International Corp. in March 2017. Its principal operations are based in Westlake Village, California.
